hooks.name: Run test suites on engine/content changes
hooks.description: After saving engine.js, schema.js, renderer.js, or a game.json, runs both test suites (forgotten-temple and case-zero) and reports results.

action.command: echo '=== forgotten-temple ===' && node forgotten-temple/tests.js && echo '=== case-zero ===' && node case-zero/tests.js
